---
title: "Welcome"
---

These are hands-on workshops. You won't watch slides about AI, you'll experience AI-augmented work directly, using VS Code + Claude Code: an agentic AI tool that reads files, writes files, and runs commands on your machine. Until recently this stack belonged to software engineers. Now it belongs to everyone, consultants, product managers, and researchers included. Both sessions put that claim to the test with your own hands on the keyboard, then ask what it means for the research we should be doing.

## Before either session: complete the [Setup page](00-setup.qmd) (~30 min)

Both workshops go hands-on within minutes of starting, so there's very little setup time in the room. Installing the stack ahead of time, Claude Pro, GitHub, VS Code, Claude Code, and running the 2-minute verification checklist at the bottom of the setup page is the single best thing you can do to get value out of the session. If something doesn't work on the day, come 15 minutes early or pair up with a neighbor whose laptop is running. Nobody sits out.
:::

Attending both? Do setup once, the same stack powers both rooms.
